ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by dominant high-intensity (white) central surfaces (~75% of visible area) against low-intensity (black/dark grey) peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white geometric area covering most of the left lobe; a secondary, more restricted white region on the right lobe. Black pigmentation is concentrated at the peduncle insertion and extends along the trailing and lateral margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a central convergence angle of approximately 45-55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire superior boundary, featuring numerous pixel-level peaks and valleys ranging from 2-10 pixels in amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe displays a blunt, truncated convex curve at the tip; right lobe displays an elongated, tapered convex sweep towards a pointed tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of three distinct low-intensity (dark) circular clusters located on the white ventral field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme raggedness and apparent morphological irregularity on the distal end of the left lobe, indicating potential tissue loss or prior trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced bilateral asymmetry between the blunt morphology of the left lobe tip and the acute morphology of the right lobe tip.
